root_cause.text: The rxrpc DATA and RESPONSE packet handlers only unshare the skb for in-place decryption when skb_cloned() is true, but fail to also unshare when the skb is not cloned yet carries externally-owned paged fragments (e.g., via SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG or frag list), allowing shared pages to be bound directly into cryptographic scatter-gather lists.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "The DATA-packet handler ... copy the skb to a linear one before calling into the security ops only when skb_cloned() is true. An skb that is not cloned but still carries externally-owned paged fragments ... falls through to the in-place decryption path, which binds the frag pages directly into the AEAD/skcipher SGL via skb_to_sgvec()." The patch extends the condition to include skb_has_frag_list() and skb_has_shared_frag().

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix insufficient skb sharing check before in-place decryption by also testing for frag list and shared frags.
intent_record.what: Added two additional conditions (skb_has_frag_list and skb_has_shared_frag) to the existing skb_cloned check in the if statement that determines whether to unshare the skb before in-place decryption in rxrpc_input_call_event.
intent_record.how: The change ensures that the skb is unshared not only when it is cloned, but also when it has a frag list or shared frags, preventing potential data corruption during in-place decryption by ensuring exclusive ownership of the skb.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix insufficient condition for copying skb before in-place decryption by also checking for frag list and shared fragments to prevent data corruption.
intent_record.what: Expanded the conditional check from only 'skb_cloned(skb)' to also include 'skb_has_frag_list(skb)' and 'skb_has_shared_frag(skb)' before copying the packet for in-place decryption.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function will now copy the skb if it is cloned, has a frag list, or has shared fragments, ensuring in-place decryption does not corrupt shared data in those additional cases.
